description: Add the Resend email module (confirmation emails + results emails), wire the results email into the deterministic assessment flow, align the cohort concept to free-text-named GROUPS (grupo/evento/colegio) while preserving the anonymous group-student flow and the QR->assigned-method routing, add ADMIN user role management to the admin panel, and update the docs. Depends on FEAT-001 (RAG removed) and FEAT-002 (credentials auth + roles + seed).
steps: Add dep in web/: npm install resend.

Create web/lib/email/client.ts (or web/lib/email.ts): a LAZY Resend client that reads RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM at call time. Export isEmailConfigured() (true iff RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM set) and a low-level sendEmail({to, subject, html, text}) that: if not configured, does NOT throw - it logs a clear Spanish message and returns {sent:false, skipped:true} so the app degrades gracefully and the no-env build/runtime never crash. When configured, calls resend.emails.send and returns {sent:true}. Nothing runs at import; no top-level env read.

Create web/lib/email/messages.ts: pure builders returning {subject, html, text} in Spanish. buildVerificationEmail({displayName, verifyUrl}) for account confirmation. buildResultsEmail({studentName, methodName, dominantCode, interpretation, resultsUrl}) containing the deterministic result summary (dominant areas + interpretation text from the method engine, which is derived from the bibliography) AND a link to the results page. These are pure functions (easy to unit test).

Wire verification email: in the registerAction (FEAT-002) call a sendVerificationEmail(email, displayName, token) helper that builds verifyUrl from NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL (or request origin) + /verify?token=... and sends via the email module. If FEAT-002 created a placeholder, replace it with the real Resend-backed send here.

Wire results email into web/app/api/sessions/route.ts: after persistSession succeeds, if a studentEmail is present, build the results email (method name via getMethod(methodId).name, dominantCode, deterministic interpretation from methodScores.interpretation or dominantSummary, resultsUrl = origin + /results/{id}) and call sendEmail best-effort. A failed/absent email must NOT fail the 201 response (wrap in try/catch, log Spanish). Determine the base URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL or the request headers. Keep the deterministic computation unchanged.

Groups free-text name UX: the cohort concept becomes 'grupo'. In web/components/AdminClient.tsx rename the visible tab/labels from 'Cohortes' to 'Grupos' and field labels to 'Nombre del grupo' (maps to title), keep a stable code/slug for the URL/QR. If the user leaves the code blank, auto-generate a slug from the free-text name (e.g. slugify + short random suffix) so admins only need to type a name like 'Evento 1' or 'Colegio 1'. Preserve the per-group method selector (METHOD_OPTIONS) and QR generation. Update web/lib/actions/cohorts.ts createCohort to accept a name and derive/accept the code accordingly (keep code UNIQUE, uppercased slug), keep authorizeStaffWithRoles(['SUPER_ADMIN','TEST_ADMIN']). Do NOT break /g/[code] -> /assessment?cohort=CODE&method=METHOD routing, lib/qr.ts, or QrCode.tsx. Keep listCohorts merging DB + seed.

Preserve anonymous group-student flow: students entering via /g/{code} provide ONLY their email on the assessment form (no password, no verification) - confirm web/components/AssessmentClient.tsx keeps the email-only entry for cohort/group takers and that /api/sessions accepts anonymous submissions (currentUser null path already stores body.studentEmail). No account is created for group students. Individuals without a group register (FEAT-002) and take the test on their own; staff have accounts.

Admin user role management: add a 'Usuarios' capability in web/components/AdminClient.tsx (and a server action, e.g. web/lib/actions/users.ts setUserRole({email, role})) that lets a SUPER_ADMIN list users and assign a role (Tester/Profesor/Revisor/Admin/Estudiante) to a chosen user. Authorize with authorizeStaffWithRoles(['SUPER_ADMIN']) (only admin assigns elevated roles). Persist to app_users.role in Neon (lazy query). Provide a matching listUsers() (staff-only). Keep all labels Spanish. If wiring a full UI is large, implement the server action + a minimal but functional admin form; assign-role must actually update the DB.
Update web/app/admin/page.tsx if it referenced removed AI/knowledge tabs; ensure it renders AdminClient with the groups + evaluaciones + usuarios sections and passes currentUser/role.

Docs: update web/README.md and repo-root README.md (Spanish): describe the NEW architecture - deterministic analysis by the 5 method engines (no IA/RAG), self-hosted email+password auth with Resend email verification, the role model (Admin/Tester/Profesor/Revisor/Estudiante) and who needs an account (group students = anonymous email-only; individuals + staff = register/login), the seeded initial admin (admin@orientapp.local / OrientApp!Admin2026) with a clear note to CHANGE it after first login and the optional INITIAL_ADMIN_* overrides, free-text-named groups with QR->assigned method, and the full env var list (DATABASE_URL, AUTH_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM, INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD, legacy STAFF_ACCESS_TOKEN). Remove references to Google OAuth, Tutor IA, base de conocimiento (RAG), pgvector and AI settings. Update SDD_ORIENTAPP_V2.md references only if it blocks the build (it does not); at minimum add a short note in README that the design pivoted away from OAuth+RAG.
Add RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM to web/.env.example with Spanish comments explaining graceful degradation when unset (emails are skipped, app keeps working, build passes).

Tests (Vitest): web/tests/email-messages.test.ts (buildVerificationEmail includes the verify URL/token and Spanish subject; buildResultsEmail includes the dominant code, the deterministic interpretation text, and the results URL). web/tests/email-client.test.ts (sendEmail returns skipped:true and does NOT throw when RESEND_API_KEY/EMAIL_FROM unset; when configured with a mocked resend module it calls emails.send with the from/to/subject). Optionally a test that /api/sessions still returns 201 when the email send is skipped. Update AdminClient/cohorts/users tests as needed. Keep the whole suite green with real assertions.
Run full verification: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test -- --run, and the no-env build (env -u DATABASE_URL -u AUTH_SECRET -u RESEND_API_KEY -u EMAIL_FROM npm run build).
acceptance_criteria: web/lib/email module lazily reads RESEND_API_KEY + EMAIL_FROM; sendEmail returns a skipped result and never throws when unset; when configured it calls Resend's emails.send (verified via mock).

Registration triggers a Spanish confirmation email (verify link) via the email module; results are emailed (best-effort) to the student/individual after completing the test, containing the deterministic result summary and a link to the results page.
A failed or skipped results email does NOT change the /api/sessions 201 success.

Groups have free-text names in the admin UI (labelled 'Grupos' / 'Nombre del grupo'); a stable code/slug backs the URL/QR; per-group method assignment is preserved and /g/{code} still routes to /assessment with the assigned method.
Group students remain anonymous (email-only entry, no account, no password/verification); individuals and staff use register/login.
An admin (SUPER_ADMIN) can assign roles (Tester/Profesor/Revisor/Admin/Estudiante) to a chosen user and the change persists to app_users.role; the action is authorized to SUPER_ADMIN only.
README (repo + web) and .env.example reflect the new architecture (no Google/RAG/AI/pgvector), document the seeded admin and how to change it, and list all env vars with Spanish comments.
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test -- --run pass, and the no-env build succeeds with DATABASE_URL/AUTH_SECRET/RESEND_API_KEY/EMAIL_FROM all unset.
verification: cd web && env -u DATABASE_URL -u AUTH_SECRET -u RESEND_API_KEY -u EMAIL_FROM npm run build
grep -rE 'Google|RAG|pgvector|Tutor IA|base de conocimiento' web/README.md README.md (expect no active references except historical pivot note)
